meta.name: etetoolkit
meta.description: Analyzes, manipulates, compares, annotates, and visualizes phylogenetic or other hierarchical trees with ETE 4. Supports Newick/Nexus tree I/O, topology edits and pattern matching, Robinson-Foulds comparisons, gene-tree evolutionary events and reconciliation, NCBI/GTDB taxonomy, SmartView exploration, and publication rendering. Applies to existing trees after alignment and phylogenetic inference, rather than inferring trees from raw sequences.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把已有的进化树读进来,做拓扑编辑、比较与出版级配图
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果比对和建树已完成,只差分析、比较和美化这棵进化树
copy.tagline_en: Load an existing tree to edit, compare and render it for publication
copy.fit_line_en: For you if the tree is already built and you need to analyse, compare or publish it

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能读写、修剪、重新生根 Newick/NHX 等格式的系统发育树，比较树间拓扑差异，检测基因树上的复制与物种分化事件并提取直系同源组，结合 NCBI 分类信息给树注释，还能渲染 PDF/SVG 图。
howto.when: 当你有已建好的树文件（Newick/NHX 等），想修改、比较、注释或出图时触发；它不负责从原始序列推断树。

say.text: 帮我读一下 tree.nw，重新生根到中点，只保留我指定的几个物种
say.note: 输出修剪并生根后的新树文件

say.text: 把这个基因树按支持度上色，导出成 PDF
say.note: 生成矢量图文件供发表使用

howto.what_en: Claude can read, prune, reroot, and compare phylogenetic trees (Newick/NHX), detect duplication and speciation events on gene trees, extract ortholog groups, annotate trees with NCBI taxonomy, and render PDF/SVG figures.
howto.when_en: Use when you already have tree files (Newick/NHX) to edit, compare, annotate, or visualize; it does not infer trees from raw sequences.

say_en.text: Read tree.nw, reroot it at the midpoint, and keep only my chosen species
say_en.note: Writes a pruned, rerooted tree file

say_en.text: Compare tree1.nw and tree2.nw with Robinson-Foulds distance
say_en.note: Returns RF distance and shared leaves

say_en.text: Color this gene tree by support and export it as PDF
